data.name: Prabhakar
data.gender_notes: Prabhakar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Prabhakar is a Sanskrit name that means 'shining forth with the light of knowledge'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'prabh' meaning 'shining forth' and 'kara' meaning 'doer'. This name is associated with the god Prabhakar, who is the embodiment of knowledge and wisdom. The name Prabhakar carries the meaning “God of Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Prabhakar usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Prabhakar is a spiritual name that represents the inner light of knowledge and wisdom. It is a reminder to seek knowledge and wisdom in all aspects of life, and to share this knowledge with others to help them grow and evolve.
data.etymology: Prabhakar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Prabhakar total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
